evals.name: wrong-lever-trap
evals.prompt: Level 1 feels like it takes forever before anything actually happens. Can you bump the heroes' move speed so they get to the fight faster?
evals.expected_output: Redirects from the hero-stat lever (last resort, affects everything) to diagnosing traversal/layout; should surface the ~5500px deploy-to-lair gap and note it exceeds the distance that structurally broke V1's L1; should not silently just edit move_speed.

evals.name: vague-too-easy
evals.prompt: Game feels too easy once I've bought a couple of upgrades. What should we change?
evals.expected_output: Refuses to tune toward the adjective; pins down WHICH part feels easy, asks for or proposes a diagnosis, notes nothing in the lane build has ever been swept and there is no harness, distinguishes structural vs tuning.
